data.one_liner: A view model library with automatic lifecycle management and dependency resolution.
data.what_it_does: Manage state, lifecycle, and dependency composition using ViewModels and bindings. It prevents memory leaks and shares state across widgets or plain Dart classes without needing a widget tree.
use_when: You want automatic lifecycle management and disposal for view models.
You need to share state and manage dependencies outside the widget tree.
You want explicit ownership models for view model instances.
avoid_when: You prefer stream-based architecture like BLoC.
You are already heavily invested in Provider or Riverpod for your architecture.
strengths: Independent of the widget tree, usable in plain Dart classes.
Automatic lifecycle management prevents memory leaks.
Supports composition of modules through ownership bindings.
weaknesses: Global registry and configuration are process-global, requiring sequential tests.
Requires understanding specific spec and binding rules.
data.setup_notes: Optionally enable the view_model_lint analyzer plugin in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a compile-safe, provider-based dependency injection and state management solution.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a strict, predictable event-to-state stream-based architecture.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight and traditional Flutter dependency injection and state propagation tool.
